remarks:
Welcome to Point Chautauqua! Offered for the first time, this contemporary home has been owned and loved by the same family since it was built. Located in one of Chautauqua Lake’s most distinctive communities. The Point Chautauqua Community offers many amenities including, lake access, boat docking, beach, walking paths, tennis/pickle ball courts and more!  

Step inside to a spacious great room where soaring vaulted ceilings, exposed beams and a dramatic wall of windows fill the space with natural light. A beautiful stone wood-burning fireplace anchors the room and adds warmth and character.

The thoughtfully designed first floor offers convenient main-level living with a primary bedroom featuring a private full bath with walk-in shower, two additional bedrooms, another full bath and half bath, plus first-floor laundry. The kitchen offers plenty of cabinetry, a large center island with seating and flows into the dining area with access to the outdoors.

Upstairs, a generously sized fourth bedroom and full bath provide a private space for guests or a home office. A full unfinished basement offers an abundance of storage and plenty of possibilities for future use.

Outside, mature trees, beautiful landscaping and established gardens surround the home, creating a peaceful setting with multiple areas to relax and enjoy the outdoors. A detached two-car garage provides additional convenience.

Point Chautauqua residents enjoy a truly special lakeside setting designed by landscape architect Frederick Law Olmsted. With 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, boat dock opportunities and a flexible floor plan designed for both everyday living and entertaining, this is a wonderful chance to make Point Chautauqua home.
